The XECH Prism Table Lamp and digital clock is a perfect blend of smart technology, modern design, and everyday convenience. Designed for homes, offices, and study spaces, this innovative product combines a stylish  with a Bluetooth-enabled digital , delivering both functional lighting and precise time management in one compact unit.

Featuring Bluetooth-enabled with auto time sync, the ensures accurate time display without manual adjustments. Whether placed on a bedside table, study desk, or work station, this smart lamp enhances productivity, comfort, and organization while adding a premium aesthetic to your space.

The integrated Bluetooth digital automatically syncs time with your smartphone, eliminating the hassle of resetting after power interruptions. With dual alarms with snooze function, the lamp is ideal for couples, students, or professionals managing different schedules. The large multi-colored digital display offers excellent visibility from a distance, making it easy to check the time even in low-light conditions. The vibrant display adds a modern touch while remaining easy on the eyes.

Customizable with 3 Colour Tones

The allows you to switch between warm, neutral, and cool lighting to suit different moods and tasks. Whether you’re reading, working, studying, or relaxing, the adapts to your needs with a simple touch. Its flexible gooseneck with wide lamp head provides precise light positioning and uniform brightness across your workspace. This makes it an excellent choice as a desk lamp for students, professionals, and home offices.

USB-C Rechargeable & Plug-and-Play Convenience

Built for modern lifestyles, the features USB-C rechargeable & plug-and-play operation. Use it wirelessly after charging or keep it plugged in for continuous use. The energy-efficient LED lighting ensures long-lasting performance with minimal power consumption. This USB-C rechargeable desk lamp is travel-friendly and ideal for spaces where power outlets are limited, making it a versatile lighting solution for both home and office environments.

Built-In for Better Organization
